SELECT s.format, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) nd, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.quantity) qty, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, min(f.etl_loaded_at) l0, max(f.etl_loaded_at) l1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT s.format, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(r.quantity_returned) q, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

r AS (SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date d, sum(r.refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY 1,2)

-- Share of period 2 sales (FY2025/26 P02) that was refunded, by store format, excl. web shop and training store
WITH p AS (
  SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
sold AS (
  SELECT st.format, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
  WHERE st.store_id < 900
),
refunded AS (
  SELECT s.sales_line_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM sold s JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY s.sales_line_id
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format,
  round(100 * coalesce(sum(rf.refund_net), 0) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_share_pct
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN refunded rf ON rf.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
